description: Machine-readable registry of AiXia QA severity levels and release governance defaults.

levels.name: Critical
levels.definition: Permission, security, or data leak risk, tenant isolation risk, finance or HR sensitive exposure, wrong financial data, destructive action risk, production route failure, build failure, or backend data corruption risk.
useWhen: Cross-tenant data exposure is possible or proven
Sensitive finance or payroll data is visible to the wrong role
Destructive actions lack confirmation or audit where required
Data integrity or corruption risk is present

levels.name: High
levels.definition: Major broken workflow, failed create, edit, archive, restore, or delete, broken registry, broken AI action, failed HR or payroll workflow, or severe user-blocking bug.
useWhen: Primary workflow cannot complete for an authorized role
Core registry or list views fail to load or mutate correctly
Repeated failures block finance or HR operations

levels.name: Medium
levels.definition: Important usability, design, or functionality issue that does not fully block the workflow.
useWhen: Workaround exists but quality or trust is materially reduced
Issue affects a secondary path or subset of users
Issue is isolated but important for operational clarity

levels.name: Low
levels.definition: Minor visual, text, spacing, alignment, or non-blocking issue.
useWhen: Cosmetic defect with no workflow impact
Copy or spacing inconsistency without blocking confusion
Minor alignment issue on non-critical screens

levels.name: Suggestion
useWhen: Enhancement idea without a reproducible defect
Product or SaaS packaging idea pending council review
UX polish that is optional relative to current scope
